Areas above or approaching timberline were considered
unsuitable and were delineated as areas with average
temperature below 6.5 8C (Korner and Paulsen, 2004), over
the length of growing season, as calculated from the
WorldClim dataset (Hijmans et al., 2004). Although tree-
line can surpass 4000 m in certain parts of the world, CDM
projects are here assumed to be unrealistic at elevations
above 3500 m because of slow tree growth rates. Thus,
additionally all land above 3500 m (based on the SRTM
DEM) was excluded.
